ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

3. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).
   D. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.

   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
